title: Beliefs change what happens next
subtitle: How we interpret an event shapes its consequence. Each consequence starts the next pass; examination opens another route.

events.label: Activating event
events.caption: Something happens, such as a tense conversation.

events.label: Next event
events.caption: The first consequence becomes the next thing that happens.

states.label: Belief
states.caption: How the event is interpreted in the moment.

states.label: Updated belief
states.caption: Shaped by what the first consequence taught.

examination.label: Examination
examination.caption: Question the belief: is it accurate, and is it useful?

outcome.label: Revised outlook
outcome.caption: A more flexible way to read the next event.

footer.note: Schematic: the stages and outcomes are illustrative, not measured.
footer.source: After the ABC model of cognitive-behavioural therapy (A activating event, B belief, C consequence), with D and E shown as examination and revised outlook.
